subject: Observability onboarding: FinLogix integration and runbook/alert mapping
body:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Amelia Torres <amelia@finlogix.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Observability onboarding: sync and deliverables for FinLogix

Amelia — thanks again for the walkthrough this morning. Per our call, I wanted to capture a clear set of deliverables and owners so we can hit the target pilot date (tentatively July 10). Attached: an implementation matrix and our base runbook template for your review.

Top-level goals for the onboarding:
- Deliver core dashboards (latency, error rate, token-cost trends) scoped to FinLogix production traffic.
- Add tracing hooks for request->backend spans so we can correlate slow tails to specific model variants.
- Agree an error taxonomy and map to alert routing + escalation paths.
- Publish a runbook that CS, SRE, and FinLogix on-call can follow during the first two weeks after cutover.

Proposed task owners (internal):
- Dashboards & metrics mapping: Marissa Cole
- Tracing integration / SDK notes: Aditya Rao
- Infrastructure routing & alert groups: Connor O'Brien
- Program lead / CS coordination: Laura Bennett (me)

Can you confirm the FinLogix on-call contacts and whether the telemetry map you shared covers sampling/rate limits? If you prefer, we can run a short working session with engineers next Tue (6/24) to go line-by-line on the matrix.

Attachments: redwood-obs-implementation-matrix.xlsx; runbook-template.md

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

-----
From: Amelia Torres <amelia@finlogix.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: ops-eng@finlogix.com
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability onboarding: sync and deliverables for FinLogix

Thanks, Laura — this looks good. We can confirm the pilot window and our SREs are available for a working session on Tue 6/24 at 10:00 PT. FinLogix on-call for production is:
- Diego Marquez (diego.marquez@finlogix.com) — primary
- Priya Shah (priya.shah@finlogix.com) — secondary

A couple notes from our side:
- Our telemetry map (attached) shows we currently sample traces at 5% and emit request-level metrics to Prometheus. We can bump sampling for a 48-hour window during the pilot if Redwood needs higher fidelity.
- We use a short-form error code system (E100–E199 = client, E200–E299 = infra). Happy to map those to Redwood taxonomy as part of next week's session.

Attached: finlogix-telemetry-map.pdf

—Amelia
Amelia Torres
Head of Platform Engineering | FinLogix
amelia@finlogix.com

-----
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Amelia Torres <amelia@finlogix.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Jun 2025 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability onboarding: sync and deliverables for FinLogix

Thanks for the on-call list and the sampling note — helpful. Quick updates / asks before Tue: 
1) Marissa will draft the dashboard spec (widgets + queries) and share by EOD Mon so FinLogix can comment.
2) Aditya to provide a short SDK change checklist (tracing hook placement + header propagation) and estimated dev time.
3) Connor will propose alert groups and a proposed SLA ladder (warning -> P1).
4) Hannah Schmitt (PM) is looped in for go-live gating and success metrics.

Please review the runbook-template.md (attached). The goal is to have a runbook with: triage flow, rollback steps, contact matrix, and an annotated dashboard link. If FinLogix wants to keep sampling at 5% we can still proceed, but tracing gaps may limit root cause fidelity — hence the optional 48-hour sample bump during pilot.

Action: Can FinLogix confirm by EOD Mon if they want sampling increased during the pilot window? If not, we'll proceed with the dashboards + metric correlation plan and add notes where tracing coverage is incomplete.

Best,
Laura

-----
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Amelia Torres <amelia@finlogix.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Jun 2025 12:31:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability onboarding: tracing hook details

Quick technical note from my side before the 6/24 session:
- For reliable span correlation we need FinLogix to propagate the incoming request-id header through the model-serving path into the Redis-based cache layer and back into the response. Right now we get a generic request tag in the Prometheus metric but not a stable trace id across async jobs.
- SDK change: add X-FinReq-ID header passthrough and ensure our instrumentation libraries extract it as the parent trace. Estimated dev work: 1 engineer for ~2.5 days to implement + 1 day QA.
- Alternative: if FinLogix can push an enriched metadata tag into the Kafka topic (request metadata) we can backfill correlations without touching all SDK callsites. This reduces dev work but requires producer changes.

I'll bring a short example patch to the call showing the header extraction logic.

—Aditya
Lead Infra Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com

-----
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Amelia Torres <amelia@finlogix.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Jun 2025 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability onboarding: runbook & alert routing confirmation

All — short next steps from CS/ops perspective (will manage the checklist during pilot):
- Marissa: Dashboard spec draft (link will be posted to the Drive doc) — ETA Mon 6/23 EOD.
- Connor: Proposed alert groups + escalation matrix — ETA Tue 6/24 AM (before the working session).
- Aditya: bring example tracing patch + quick QA checklist to 6/24 session.
- FinLogix: confirm sampling bump for 48 hours during pilot by Mon 6/23 EOD.

Please confirm that the alert failure modes we should prioritize are: model-serving latency spikes (>95th pctl), token-cost regression (+30% vs baseline), and elevated E2XX error-class (E200–E249) originating from our infra layer. If FinLogix wants different priority ordering, call it out in the Drive doc.

I'll own the runbook publication and will make sure alerts are mirrored in your Ops Slack channel when we flip the pilot.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
CS Ops | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
